title: Reviewing Order Entry Values

children:
These values are used by the system for various purposes in the Order 
 Entry system. You can edit these values to meet your business needs.

Below are descriptions of the order entry values. You can review and/or 
 edit the following values:

Perform Item Availability Checking? 
 - This value indicates that the system will check to see if an item quantity 
 is in stock in the warehouse. This system check will occur during order 
 entry or shipment creation.

Should In Pool Quantities Count As 
 Allocated? - This value indicates whether or not the validation 
 performed by the "Available Checking" value (described above) 
 will include quantities for shipments already in the order pool. For example:

- When 
 the value is Y, shipments in the pool that need this item will 
 actually decrement the available quantity for the purposes of availability 
 checking. Suppose you have 20 of item AA001 in the warehouse with 10 allocated. 
 You also have a shipment in the pool that requires 4 of AA001. The system 
 thinks there are 6 available (20 on hand - 10 allocated - 4 for the shipment 
 in the pool = 6).

- When the value is N, (using 
 the example above), the system thinks there are 10 available (20 on hand 
 - 10 allocated = 10).

Header Customer Field Required 
 - This value allows you to configure the Customer Field (header level) 
 as being required during the order entry process. This validation will 
 be enforced for both orders entered on the Order Entry Window (for multiple 
 orders), and the Shipment Screen (for single orders).

Order Entry Ship To Max - This 
 value defines the number of ship to addresses you can add to an order 
 before the system will display a warning about loading default fields. 
 When you leave the Ship To Selection screen, the system will alert you 
 asking if you want the option of not populating the default customer information 
 fields on the following screens: the Default Carrier/Service Field on 
 the Routing Selection Screen, and the Default Categories Field on the 
 Miscellaneous Selection screen. This is helpful because the large number 
 of ship to's that the system has to retrieve data for could increase load 
 time significantly.

Header Ship To Field Required 
 - This value allows you to configure the Ship To Field (header level) 
 as being required during the order entry process. This validation will 
 be enforced for both orders entered on the Order Entry Window (for multiple 
 orders), and the Shipment Screen (for single orders).

Order Id Prefix - This value 
 defines the default value for the Order ID Prefix Field (in the Order 
 Entry Window). The system will insert this value if no Order ID Prefix 
 has been defined for the company in the Company Window.

Shipment Header User Defined Fields 
 1-8 Required - These values allow you to configure the user defined 
 fields in order entry as being required fields. The system will perform 
 a validation (in the Order Entry Window for multiple orders, and the Shipment 
 Screen for single orders) to ensure that the user enters a value 
 for the specified user defined field.

Allow different company on Shipment Hdr and Dtls? - This value indicates whether or not the system will allow the creation of a shipment that has different company values on the header and detail(s). Note that this affects shipments created via the Order Entry Window and the interface, not shipments manually created using the Shipment/Shipment Line Screens.
